sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.lead: Sign in to set up your robots, and share them with the people in your home.
sign_in.ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
sign_in.development.title: A test person
sign_in.development.lead: The development cloud signs in anyone by name and email, without Google or Apple.
sign_in.name: Name
sign_in.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
sign_in.email.hint: Optional. The same email is the same person.
sign_in.email.error: This is not an email address.
cloud.unreachable: The cloud cannot be reached. Check your connection, then try again.
cloud.unavailable: The cloud cannot serve just now. Try again later.
cloud.busy: Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.
cloud.failed: That did not work. Try again.

homes.empty: You have no home yet. Your homes, and the robots in them, will show here.
homes.kind.profile: A profile, who does not sign in
homes.new.title: A new home
homes.new.name: Name
homes.new.name.hint: As everyone in the home will see it.
homes.new.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
homes.new.limit: You are in as many homes as an account may be.
homes.missing: You are not in this home.
homes.invitation.revoke.which: Revoke the invitation from {$name}, which expires {$time :datetime dateFields=month-day dateLength=long timePrecision=minute}
homes.invite.title: Invite someone
homes.invite.lead: Make a link that lets one person join {$home}. They sign in, and join as a member.
homes.invite.caution: Anyone who has the link can use it, so send it only to the person you mean.
homes.invite.limit: This home has as many invitations not yet used as it may have. Revoke one on the home's page first.
homes.invite.code: A QR code of the link
homes.invite.scan: The person you invite scans it with the app, from Join a home.
homes.invite.expires: It works once, and expires {$time :datetime dateFields=month-day dateLength=long timePrecision=minute}.
homes.invite.once: The app shows this link only now. If it is lost, revoke it on the home's page, and make another.
homes.profile.title: Add a profile
homes.profile.lead: For someone in {$home} who does not sign in to the app.
homes.profile.name: Name
homes.profile.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
homes.profile.limit: This home has as many people as it may have.
homes.person.title: A person in the home
homes.person.missing: This person is no longer in the home.
homes.person.name: Name in this home
homes.person.name.hint: As everyone in the home sees it.
homes.person.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
homes.person.changed: Someone changed this person meanwhile, and the page shows them as they are now. Save again if you still want your change.
homes.person.not_allowed: Your role in this home does not allow this.
homes.person.role.admin: Changes the home, invites people, adds profiles, and renames or removes members and profiles.
homes.person.role.member: Uses the home's robots, and sees who is in it.
homes.person.role.changed: Someone changed this person meanwhile, and the page shows them as they are now. Choose again if you still want your change.
homes.person.role.revoked: Invitations from {$name} not yet used are revoked.
homes.person.remove.title: Remove {$name}?
homes.person.remove.account: What belongs to them in this home is deleted. Their account and their other homes stay.
homes.person.remove.profile: The profile is deleted, with what belongs to it in this home.
homes.person.leave.title: Leave {$home}?
homes.person.leave.message: What belongs to you in this home is deleted. You can come back only with a new invitation.
devices.title: Devices
devices.empty: No devices in this home yet.
devices.device.title: A device in the home
devices.device.missing: This device is no longer in the home.
devices.device.name: Name in this home
devices.device.name.hint: As everyone in the home sees it.
devices.device.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
devices.device.changed: Someone changed this device meanwhile, and the page shows it as it is now. Save again if you still want your change.
devices.device.not_allowed: Your role in this home does not allow this.
devices.device.remove.title: Remove {$name}?
devices.device.remove.message.robot: It leaves {$home}, and can be set up again. It keeps its Wi-Fi network, its name and its settings. To give it to someone else, reset it instead: hold a finger on its face, then choose Settings > About > Reset to factory settings. If it is online, it leaves the home by itself.
devices.device.remove.message.device: It leaves {$home}, and can be set up again. It keeps its Wi-Fi network, its name and its settings: reset it to its factory settings before you give it to someone else.
setup.title: Add a device
setup.not_allowed: Only the home's owner and its admins can add devices.
setup.intro.title: Add a device to {$home}
setup.intro.lead: Turn the device on, and keep it close to this phone. Its screen shows a QR code for set-up.
setup.intro.bluetooth: The app finds the device over Bluetooth, which the phone asks you to allow, then reads its code with the camera.
setup.radio.blocked: Bluetooth is turned off for the app, which needs it to find the device. You can turn it on in the phone's settings.
setup.radio.off: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then try again.
setup.radio.unsupported: This version of the app cannot use Bluetooth, which setting up a device needs. Use the app installed on a phone.
setup.code.reason: The app uses the camera to read the QR code on the device's screen.
setup.code.refused: This QR code is not a device's set-up code.
setup.code.hint: The 8 digits under the QR code, on the device's screen.
setup.code.error: Type the 8 digits that the device shows.
setup.discriminator.lead: Several devices nearby are in set-up. To find this one, type the 4 characters shown beside its code.
setup.discriminator.hint: 4 characters: digits, and letters from A to F.
setup.discriminator.error: Type the 4 characters shown beside the code.
setup.working.checking: Checking that the device reaches the Internet
setup.working.scanning: The device is looking for Wi-Fi networks
setup.working.joining: The device is joining the network
setup.working.adding: Adding the device to the home
setup.failed.none: No device in set-up was found nearby. Check that it is on and shows its code, and keep the phone close to it.
setup.failed.expired: The device's code has changed. Scan or type the code it shows now.
setup.failed.code: That code was not the right one, and the device shows a new one now. Scan or type the new code.
setup.failed.busy: The device is being set up from another phone. Wait until that is over, then try again.
setup.failed.version: This device needs a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
setup.failed.taken: This device is in another home. Someone there must remove it from that home, or the device must be reset, before it can join this one.
setup.failed.full: This home has as many devices as it can hold. Remove one to add another.
setup.failed.not_allowed: Your role in this home does not allow adding devices.
setup.failed.interrupted: The connection to the device was lost. Keep the phone close to it, then try again.
setup.failed.broken: Set-up stopped: the device answered in a way the app does not expect. Try again.
setup.networks.title: Choose a Wi-Fi network for the device
setup.networks.empty: The device sees no Wi-Fi network. Move it closer to the router, then look again.
setup.join.wrong_password: The network refused the password. Check it, then try again.
setup.join.not_found: The device cannot reach that network. Move it closer to the router, then try again.
setup.join.no_address: The network gave the device no address. Check the router, then try again.
setup.join.network: The device could not join that network. Try again, or choose another.
setup.hidden.not_found: The device found no network by that name. Check the name, in which capitals count, and the security. Or make the network visible for a while, and choose it in the list.
setup.password.title: Password for {$name}
setup.password.error.wpa2: Type 8 to 63 characters, or 64 hexadecimal digits.
setup.password.error.wpa3: Type a password of up to 128 characters.
setup.hidden.title: Other network
setup.hidden.lead: For a network that does not show its name. To find it, the device sends that name over the air.
setup.hidden.name: Network name
setup.hidden.name.hint: As the router has it: capitals count.
setup.hidden.name.error: Type the network's name: up to 32 characters, fewer with accents or symbols.
setup.name.title: Name the device
setup.name.added: It is in {$home} now, under the name that everyone in the home sees.
setup.name.known: It was in {$home} already, under the name that everyone in the home sees.
setup.name: Name in this home
setup.name.hint: You can change it later, on its page.
setup.name.error: Type a name of up to 100 characters.
setup.name.changed: Someone renamed this device meanwhile. Continue to give it the name you typed, or change it first.
setup.ready.title: {$name} is ready
setup.ready.late: {$name} is not online yet. Check that it is on, and within reach of its Wi-Fi network. Its page shows when it comes online.
setup.moved.title: New network
setup.moved.network: The device is joining {$network}, and is back online in its home in a moment.
setup.moved.lead: The device is joining its new network, and is back online in its home in a moment.
setup.simulated.none: No simulated device: the app uses the phone's Bluetooth. Set radio to "simulated" under [setup] for some.
setup.simulated.lead: The simulated devices nearby, as their screens show them. Scan or type a code in "Add a device".
join.title: Join a home
join.signed_out.title: You have an invitation
join.signed_out: Sign in to see which home it is for, and to join it.
join.lead: Scan the QR code on the phone of the person who invites you, or paste the link they sent you.
join.link.error: This is not an invitation link.
join.as_member: You will join as a member. The invitation expires {$time :datetime dateFields=month-day dateLength=long timePrecision=minute}.
join.home_limit: You are in as many homes as an account may be.
join.member_limit: This home has as many people as it may have.
join.invalid.title: This invitation cannot be used
join.invalid: It may have expired, been used, or been revoked. Ask for a new link.
join.scan.reason: The app uses the camera to read the QR code on the phone of the person who invites you.
join.scan.refused: This QR code is not an invitation.
scanner.denied: The camera is turned off for the app. You can turn it on in the phone's settings.
scanner.aim: Point the camera at the QR code.
native.camera: The camera reads the QR code of an invitation to a home.
